patches.note_zh: 10.2.2a 是 10.2.2 后的后端热修，继续通过 Backend Tunables 快速下发小幅平衡与问题修正，无需等待完整客户端补丁。BHVR patchnotes 入口当前仍未稳定挂出该条，故此处摘要取自 Steam 官方公告。
patches.note_en: 10.2.2a is a backend hotfix follow-up to 10.2.2, using Backend Tunables to ship smaller balance and issue fixes without waiting for a full client patch. The BHVR patchnotes landing page is not reliably surfacing this entry yet, so this summary comes from Steam's official announcement feed.

patches.note_zh: 10.3.0 PTB 公开了 Terrifier 章节测试服内容：新杀手 The Terrifier、配套技能与机制调整进入下一轮版本验证，说明 10 月底已开始为 11 月新章节预热。该条同样来自 Steam 官方公告。
patches.note_en: 10.3.0 PTB reveals the Terrifier chapter on the test branch, including the new Killer, related perks, and follow-up mechanical tuning, showing that DBD has already shifted into November content pre-launch by late October. This entry is also sourced from Steam's official announcement feed.

patches.note_zh: 10.2.2 延续 10.2.x 的收口节奏，集中处理 Killer Perk（如 Dark Arrogance）与一批角色、地图、交互问题，是 10 月中下旬的主要正式服修复节点。
patches.note_en: 10.2.2 continues the 10.2.x stabilization cycle, focusing on Killer Perk tuning (including Dark Arrogance) plus a batch of character, map, and interaction fixes for the live build.

patches.note_zh: 10.2.1 主要收口 10.2.0 上线后的提前结束流程：当场上仅剩 1 名人类幸存者且其余为 Bot 时，幸存者可直接选择 Surrender；当剩余幸存者全部为 Bot 时，屠夫可直接 End Trial，并移除了原先对倒地状态的限制。当前 BHVR patchnotes 落地页仍主要暴露这一篇。
patches.note_en: 10.2.1 focuses on the post-10.2.0 end-of-match flow: the last remaining human Survivor can Surrender when only bots remain on their side, and the Killer can End Trial once all remaining Survivors are bots, removing the previous dying-state restriction. This is still the article most visibly exposed by the current BHVR patchnotes landing page.

store.name: 黎明杀机
store.short_description: 10年恐惧相伴。10年的惊吓与刺激体验。10年的残暴献祭与惊险逃脱。 永久困于邪恶的幻境之中，即使死亡也无法逃脱，这是一场需要勇气和智慧的较量，四名意志坚定的逃生者在残忍对局中面对嗜血杀手。选择一方，进入多人非对称竞技游戏世界，获得最佳恐怖游戏体验。
store.short_description_en: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.
